content: In Ezra, which Persian king let the Jews go home to build God's house?
explanation: God stirred his spirit. “the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation” (Ezra 1:1, BSB)

content: In Ezra, King Cyrus told God's people to go to Jerusalem and do what?
explanation: The temple had been destroyed. “and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel” (Ezra 1:3, BSB)

content: In Ezra, why did the people give a great shout of praise?
explanation: God's house was rising again. “because the foundation of the house of the LORD had been laid.” (Ezra 3:11, BSB)

content: In Ezra, what did older people who had seen the first temple do at the new foundation?
explanation: Others shouted for joy. “wept loudly when they saw the foundation of this temple.” (Ezra 3:12, BSB)

content: In Ezra, what was Ezra skilled in?
explanation: He was a scribe. “He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses” (Ezra 7:6, BSB)

content: In Ezra, what had Ezra set his heart to do with the Law?
explanation: He lived what he taught. “For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes” (Ezra 7:10, BSB)

content: In Ezra, what did King Cyrus return that Nebuchadnezzar had taken?
explanation: They went back to Jerusalem. “King Cyrus also brought out the articles belonging to the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away” (Ezra 1:7, BSB)

content: In Ezra, why could no one tell joyful shouts from weeping?
explanation: It was heard from afar. “The people could not distinguish the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping” (Ezra 3:13, BSB)

content: In Ezra, what did the people of the land try to do to Judah's builders?
explanation: They opposed the rebuilding. “Then the people of the land set out to discourage the people of Judah and make them afraid to build.” (Ezra 4:4, BSB)

content: In Ezra, from which city did Ezra come up to Jerusalem?
explanation: God's hand was on him. “this Ezra came up from Babylon.” (Ezra 7:6, BSB)

content: In Ezra, what did Ezra proclaim to ask God for a safe journey?
explanation: He would not ask the king for soldiers. “And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast” (Ezra 8:21, BSB)

content: In Ezra, why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers?
explanation: He trusted God's hand. “For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen” (Ezra 8:22, BSB)

content: In Ezra, in which king's reign was the second temple completed?
explanation: It was his sixth year. “in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.” (Ezra 6:15, BSB)

content: In Ezra, in which month was the second temple completed?
explanation: On the third day. “And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar” (Ezra 6:15, BSB)

content: In Ezra, which leader built the altar with Jeshua the priest?
explanation: He was the son of Shealtiel. “along with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates, began to build the altar” (Ezra 3:2, BSB)

content: In Ezra, by which canal did Ezra proclaim a fast?
explanation: They prayed for safe travel. “And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast” (Ezra 8:21, BSB)
